verdict.rationale: Gumloop's core product is an in-product AI agent. You give it a goal and a set of tools, and it decides which tools to call, in what order, and when to ask you for input (docs-34, docs-1). You chat with it directly, can tell it to update its own instructions or turn a task into a skill (docs-2, docs-15), and get its outputs back as artifacts in the chat (docs-38). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality, and evidence of a ready-made assistant that works out of the box rather than agents each user configures with connectors.
